contracts_rationale: Internal DDD refactor + whole-service slice migration + a domain repository feature; the inbound REST surface moves package (adapter-in-rest -> packs.infra.api) but its OpenAPI contract is unchanged, and no new endpoint/DTO is introduced. No contracts/ artifacts are authored.
